verdict.rationale: Grafana supports provisioning-as-code (dashboards/data sources as version-controlled files), open query languages like LogQL, and an OpenAPI-exposed API for programmatic export, plus AGPL-licensed open-source core. However, there's no explicit documentation of a bulk 'export all my data' feature or standardized open-format data export (e.g., full metrics/logs/traces dump), and community threads raise concerns about AGPL licensing restricting some usage. missing for 10: explicit bulk data-export documentation, evidence of open-format full data portability, independent confirmation of export completeness.
